From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal demo — gating & stakeholder matrix (compact run-of-show)

Sophie —

Thanks again for taking time this week. As we discussed on the call, the renewal QBR will be a condensed 60-minute roadmap + demo focused on the specific infra/cost controls your SecOps team requested. To keep this tight I put together a compact run-of-show and a simple stakeholder matrix (attached).

Two asks before I lock the calendar:
- Can you confirm the primary technical attendees (engineer + SecOps) and the single exec who will join for the last 10 minutes? That will determine the demo depth.
- Any gating items from procurement (SLA or data retention questions) we should prepare for ahead of time? If so, flag the owner so we can prep a one-slide answer.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue Oct 5 — 10:00–11:00
- Wed Oct 6 — 13:00–14:00

I attached: renewal_demo_agenda_v0.2.pdf (compact run-of-show) and attendee_matrix_v3.xlsx (fill in names/roles).

If okay I’ll send a final invite and a brief pre-read the week before.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | www.redwood.ai

Attachments: renewal_demo_agenda_v0.2.pdf (1.1MB), attendee_matrix_v3.xlsx (34KB)

I’ve attached our internal attendee list as well (for your matrix) — I’ll paste Arjun’s mobile in a follow-up for day-of escalation.

Thanks,
Sophie

I’ll have a first-pass slide and a refreshed agenda by EOD Friday so Karthik can circulate the final invite.
